# AI instructions for this repository

Read `AGENTS.md` before source changes and `AI-INSTRUCTIONS.md` before editing a motion JSON. Read `docs/FORMAT.md` before changing NVMB. Keep claims aligned with the renderer: it previews one styled text element and X/Y, rotation, scale, opacity. Preserve project IDs and unknown fields, validate imported data, and never overwrite source binary files. Use `npm run check` for syntax validation and report exactly what you verified.
